name: Quiet Resolve
speaker: Protagonist
text: I won't leave until it's done.

name: Threatened Smile
speaker: Antagonist
text: You think you can stop me? Cute.

name: Warm Reassure
speaker: Friend
text: I've got you. Breathe with me.

name: Passing Stranger
speaker: Stranger
text: Sometimes the smallest choice changes everything.

name: Measured Warning
speaker: Guardian
text: There are rules you don't break without consequence.

name: Distant Echo
speaker: Narrator
text: The city held its breath between two heartbeats.
